title: Grateful Dead Live at Community War Memorial Auditorium on 1982-04-09
source: Recording Info: Beyer M160 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M); Transfer Info: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) -> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) -> KORG AudioGate 4 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC (24bit/96k); Recorded By Frank Streeter; Transferred and Mastered By Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: A well‑played, under‑the‑radar show with standout moments like China Cat Sunflower and Lay Me Down; recording sounds solid though source is unknown.
ai_review.review: Reviewers describe this 1982 performance as firing on all cylinders, highlighting the dancing groove at the four‑minute mark of China Cat Sunflower, the heartfelt delivery of Lay Me Down, and a satisfying close with Going Down The Road/Satisfaction followed by a classic Brokedown Palace encore. No specific audio complaints are noted, suggesting an adequately clear capture despite the unknown source type.

ai_rating.rationale: The single detailed review is highly positive about the musical performance and mentions no recording flaws, leading to a strong show rating with assumed decent audio.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit comments on sound quality; reviewers focus on performance, implying the recording is at least listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth set progression with energetic peaks and a strong, familiar encore.
